credits.title: Strawberries
credits.overview: Hasna and Meriem leave their native Morocco to work a season picking strawberries in Spain, until abuse and harassment shatter their hopes. Supported by a Spanish lawyer, they must decide whether to speak out against a powerful system.

credits.title: Los pájaros
credits.overview: Álvaro lives trapped between the demands of his sport and the silent violence of his home. While protecting his sister and discovering love outside the family, a pivotal night forces him to confront the burden he has silently carried for far too long.

credits.title: Golpes
credits.overview: Fresh from prison in 1980s Spain, Migueli reunites his gang for heists to settle past debts. His brother Sabino, now a cop assigned to the case, knows his methods - but Migueli won't stop until he reaches his goal.
